summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by WPP plc containing only a boilerplate forward-looking statements disclaimer and general risk factors. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed. The filing includes no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. As a foreign private issuer report with no material event, it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
